title: IBPS Clerk (CSA) 16th Online Form 2026 (11,403 Posts)
vacancyDetails: Approx. 11,403 Clerk / CSA vacancies across participating Public Sector Banks under CRP-CSA-XVI for 2027-28 cycle (final state-wise posts as per detailed notification)
qualification: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university; computer literacy as per IBPS rules; local language proficiency as required by bank/state
ageLimit: 20 to 28 years as on 01 Aug 2026 (category-wise upper age relaxation as per IBPS / Govt rules)
applicationFee: As per IBPS CRP-CSA-XVI notification (category-wise online fee)
selectionProcess: Online Preliminary Exam → Online Main Exam → Provisional Allotment
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, educational certificates, category certificate if applicable, valid ID proof
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.ibps.in
2. Open CRP CSA-XVI / Apply Online link
3. Register with email and mobile
4. Fill form, upload photo/sign/documents
5. Pay fee and submit by 21 August 2026
6. Print e-receipt and application for records
shortDescription: IBPS Clerk 16th (CRP-CSA-XVI) Online Form 2026 for ~11,403 posts. Apply 01–21 August 2026. Prelims 10–11 Oct 2026; Mains 27 Dec 2026 at ibps.in.
content:
Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associates (CRP-CSA-XVI) – popularly known as IBPS Clerk 16th.

Online registration is open from 01 August 2026 to 21 August 2026. Vacancies are approximately 11,403 across participating public sector banks (cycle 2027–28).

Important dates

  • Apply online: 01–21 Aug 2026
  • Prelims exam: 10 & 11 October 2026 (tentative)
  • Mains exam: 27 December 2026 (tentative)

Selection

Preliminary online exam → Main online exam → Provisional allotment to banks based on merit and preferences.

Apply only at ibps.in. Read the full notification for state-wise vacancies, language criteria and fee before final submission.
